description: This file is a header file for the CosaCM class, defining an interface for remote procedure calls (RPC) related to Cable Modem (CM) management. It declares method bindings for various CM operations and stub functions to be implemented, including initialization, cleanup, and specific PCM operations, as well as member variables and included libraries.

classes.name: CosaCM
classes.description: A stub class providing remote procedure call handlers for Cosa Cable Modem management. It inherits from RDKTestStubInterface and AbstractServer to facilitate RPC binding and handling.
